dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Non-germinal-center B-cell phenotype by Hans algorithm (CD10-, BCL6+, MUM1/IRF4+ in ~70%).

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: Cell-of-origin gene expression profiling would not change the first-line decision and is not needed.
dx_hans_not_abc.note: Mentions GEP COO but never states Hans non-GCB is not equivalent to ABC.

stage_iii.quote: Lugano 2014 / Ann Arbor stage III, B

stage_spleen_nodal.quote: Lugano counts the spleen as a nodal site, so splenic involvement does not by itself make stage IV.

stage_bulky_b_symptoms.quote: with bulky disease (retroperitoneal mass 11.0 x 8.1 cm, above the 10 cm threshold)

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic lesions were scored as extranodal, the stage would be IV.

mn_spleen_extranodal_count.quote: CNS-IPI is intermediate, about 2-3 depending on whether splenic involvement counts as an extranodal site.
mn_spleen_extranodal_count.note: Hedges on counting spleen but does not commit to it.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: so this is not high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 and/or BCL6 rearrangement

prog_ipi_3.quote: IPI is 3 (age over 60, LDH above ULN, stage III), which is high-intermediate.

prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.quote: Age over 60, stage III and elevated LDH each score.
prog_cns_ipi_intermediate.note: Lists the three scoring factors and intermediate risk but states the score as "about 2-3".

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Pola-R-CHP (polatuzumab vedotin, rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, prednisone) every 21 days for 6 cycles

tx_pola_preferred.quote: R-CHOP-21 is an acceptable fallback if polatuzumab cannot be obtained.
tx_pola_preferred.note: Pola-R-CHP preferred, but no mention of greater benefit in non-GCB/ABC.

tx_isrt_residual_bulk.quote: Deauville 4-5 at the retroperitoneal site: consolidation RT to about 30-36 Gy.

mn_da_epoch.quote: DA-EPOCH-R is reserved for confirmed MYC plus BCL2 and/or BCL6 double- or triple-hit disease, which is not present.

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative therapy.

hbv_prophylaxis.quote: Start entecavir 0.5 mg daily before C1, continuing at least 12 months after the last rituximab

hbv_dna_lft_monitoring.note: Baseline HBV DNA and CMP ordered, but no ongoing HBV DNA/ALT monitoring during and after therapy.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Decision: no CNS-directed prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate), and no baseline lumbar puncture or brain MRI unless neurologic symptoms appear.

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: If the residual site is Deauville 4-5 and RT is not possible, biopsy before any change in therapy.
resp_ds45_biopsy.note: Biopsy only if RT not possible; otherwise irradiates residual DS4-5 without biopsy.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: Start allopurinol 300 mg daily now. Hydrate 2-3 L/day around C1

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim or biosimilar on D4 of every cycle as primary prophylaxis

work_echo_reviewed.quote: cumulative 300 mg/m2 over 6 cycles, well under the 450 mg/m2 limit with LVEF 58%

fit_full_dose.quote: He is fit for full-dose curative therapy.

miss_hbv_dna.quote: Quantitative HBV DNA is not documented.
